maturity_time_at_deposit.meaning: value of maturityTime[depositor] at the time of deposit, which the report states is never set and retains its default of 0

withdrawal_limited_by_maturity.meaning: whether the withdrawal is limited by the depositor's maturity time (i.e. the maturity lock is enforced before withdrawal succeeds)

assumptions: The depositor is the msg.sender whose maturityTime entry is read at withdrawal.
The maturity lock is the temporal gate that should prevent withdrawal before maturityTime elapses.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the intended nonzero maturity duration or how maturityTime should be set on deposit, so the desired lock length cannot be encoded numerically.

limitations: The maturity-lock enforcement is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric maturity duration or setter logic.
Only the maturity-limit impact is formalized; the separate rewards-without-holding impact is out of scope for this plan.
